basis: Separate parent-requested read-only review after discovering original lane TS enumeration omitted two included files. Does not amend original footer or transcript.

records.rationale: Complete JSON-LD taxonomy object uses context/IRI/type strings, labels, relation objects, path string array and concept graph. No Boolean value or Boolean-typed members; conceptual Draft/Filed/Privileged labels are separate concepts, not Boolean fields in one owner.

Complete Turtle taxonomy defines scheme/concept triples, IRI relations, language-tagged labels/definition and path/root strings. No Boolean literals, Boolean datatype declarations or modeled Boolean member cluster. Concept membership does not create Boolean state flags.
